verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a BSD-2 open-source, pip-installable, self-hostable framework. The same bot file runs across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud and self-hosted setups, and community reports confirm local inference via ollama and local Whisper STT. Together these let a user keep data on infrastructure they choose, but data location is only implied by self-hosting, not documented as a residency feature. Missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for Pipecat Cloud, explicit residency or storage-location docs, independent corroboration of residency controls.
